{{Quote|Ah, nothing matches being at the helm of a ship flying through the deep, black reaches of space|translated=1|Kulton Woodle|<ref name="JTL" />}}
'''Kulton Woodle''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. He had retired by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and spent his [[Standard day/Legends|days]] outside the [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with his [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|droid]], [[J1-P0]]. During that time, he had a conversation with a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] about what he did and did not miss about life as a pilot. Kulton liked to stand outside the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in an effort to hear the stories of fellow pilots in order to relive his glory days.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It is the journey I miss, but not the destinations.|translated=1|Kulton Woodle, on space flight|<ref name="JTL" />}}
Kulton Woodle was a dark [[Color/Legends|purple]]-skinned [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who operated just prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had retired from piloting by the time of aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the height of the war. By then, he owned a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], [[J1-P0]], and he spent his [[Time/Legends|time]] outside the [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During that time, Woodle struck up a conversation with a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. The Mon Calamari told the spacer about what he did and did not miss about flying and that he enjoyed hearing the stories of his fellow pilots as they came through the Theed Spaceport.<ref name="JTL" />

==Personality and traits==
Woodle was a capable pilot and captain. He enjoyed his retirement from piloting, although he missed the feeling that came with being in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the helm of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. However, he did not miss the bureaucracy and bookkeeping that also came with piloting a freighter. Woodle preferred to spend his retirement outside the spaceport in Theed, trying to relive his glory [[Standard day/Legends|days]] by talking with other pilots and spacers. Woodle spoke [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamarian]], and, according to his [[Droid/Legends|droid]], that was the only [[Language/Legends|language]] he knew. He had gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and purple skin.<ref name="JTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kulton Woodle first appeared in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' expansion pack, [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']]. He was added with the expansion as a way to advertise to players that space flight was available in the game. Prior to [[November]] [[2005]], players could teach other players how to comprehend languages they knew how to speak. With the removal of the ability to teach these languages, however, Woodle would not speak with characters who did not learn Mon Calamarian comprehension prior to their removal.<ref name="JTL" />
